user_prompt: Our procurement team needs a way to automatically extract and compare key commercial terms—like payment terms, liability caps, and renewal dates—across our existing vendor contracts so we can identify inconsistencies before we renew or consolidate suppliers, but our current contract management system only stores PDFs and doesn't surface this data.

steps.step_name: We need a solution to automatically extract key commercial terms (payment terms, liability caps, renewal dates) from PDF-based vendor contracts in our current contract management system
We need a capability to compare extracted commercial terms across vendor contracts to identify inconsistencies for renewal and supplier consolidation decisions

intent_resolver.reason: The request requires a specialized contract analysis and comparison capability (extracting and comparing commercial terms from PDFs) that is not covered by any of the registered skills, which focus on procurement workflows, product launches, engineering changes, and compliance—not contract term extr
